Quote AST round trip preserves edited colors plus row ids, i18n label refs, bindings, formats, emphasis, ordering, and unrelated styles.
Invoice AST round trip exercises the same widget contract and preserves unstyled rows without adding synthetic styles.
Renderer behavior: two totals rows render distinct backgrounds/text colors and labelStyle overrides only its label.
Save/reopen integration confirms existing grouped-template row colors load, edits persist, and untouched header/table branding remains unchanged.
Undo/history behavior restores prior totalsRows after a committed color edit without corrupting nested metadata.
Manual quote smoke: assign visibly distinct monthly and one-time total colors, save/reopen, and verify preview and generated PDF screenshots.
Manual invoice smoke: edit an existing total row, clear one color, and verify preview/PDF plus unchanged totals calculations and bindings.
